Definition: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
BiblicalUsage: 1) fat, oil; 1a) fat, fatness; 1b) oil, olive oil; 1b1) as staple, medicament or unguent; 1b2) for anointing; 1c) fat (of fruitful land, valleys) (metaph)
